report.title: Send error report
report.intro: The program puts a zip file in Downloads and opens an e-mail that you send yourself. Attach the zip file to the e-mail.
report.item_log: The log file (what the program has done)
report.item_versions: The program's version and the Windows version
report.item_job: The state of the last run and the cuts (without text)
report.private: Your user folder and user name are hidden in the files.
report.comment_hint: What did you do, and what happened? (optional)
report.done: "{file}" is in Downloads (File Explorer shows it). Attach it to the e-mail and send it.
report.mail_attach: Attach the file "{file}" from Downloads (File Explorer shows it).
